# `array`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns an array with the given elements.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
array(expr, ...)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `array_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | - |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- array, example 1
> SELECT array(1, 2, 3);
[1,2,3]
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.1.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
